items.title: Blackstone Leads Talks to Back GTCR’s $50 Billion Global Payments Deal
items.why: Payments infrastructure consolidation could change acquirer and processing partners behind card programs over time.
items.summary_ai: Blackstone, Warburg Pincus and Apollo are reportedly in talks to help finance GTCR's take-private of Global Payments.
items.take: Payments infrastructure consolidation could change acquirer and processing partners behind card programs over time.
